english.title: Veterinarian / supervised person fail to return invalidated equine ID to issuing body upon slaughter / death of equine
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[an official veterinarian]_
(B)_[a person acting under the supervision of an official veterinarian]_

who, in accordance with Article 34(1)(c)(ii) of Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/262, was required to return an invalidated ID to the issuing body, failed to do so as soon as was reasonably practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(1), 22(4) and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
